violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ON SITE AT START OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE CUT RAW MEAT WITH GLOVED HANDS, CHANGED GLOVES TO HANDLE CLEAN DISHES WITHOUT WASHING HANDS BEFORE DONNING CLEAN GLOVES.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REMOVE GLOVES AND WASH HANDS BEFORE DONNING CLEAN GLOVES BETWEEN TASKS.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW SHELL EGGS STORED ABOVE READY TO EAT FOODS IN TURBO AIR 3 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR AND RAW SHELL EGGS STORED ABOVE KIMCHI AND PREPARED SAUCES IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: KIMCHI AT 63F, SPICY SAUCE AT 64F, TOM YUM SAUCE AT 63F, SPICY SALSA AT 60F IN TURBO AIR 1 DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO TRANSFER FOODS TO OTHER REFRIGERATION UNITS. PLEASE DO NOT STORE TCS FOODS IN REFRIGERATOR UNTIL REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOOD TEMPERATURES AT 41F OR BELOW.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: IN-HOUSE KIMCHI PREPARED FOR 5 DAYS PRIOR WITHOUT DATE MARKING.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO APPLY APPROPRIATE DATE MARKING DURING INSPECTION AND ENSURE UNUSED OR UNSOLD PORTIONS ARE DISCARDED ON 7TH DAY. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: HOUSE SESAME AND HOUSE SPICY SAUCE WITHOUT TIME DOCUMENTED FOR FOODS AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC MARKED 4 HOUR TIME LABLES WITH DISCARD TIME AT 3:00 PM. PLEASE ENSURE TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL (TPHC) DOCUMENTATION IS CONSISTENTLY RECORDED FOR FOODS USING TPHC PROCEDURES.
